purpose: Current Analysis 2 resource preparation inventory; Analysis 1 versions are not imported

computed_consequences.engine: VEP transcript consequence calculation using Sequence Ontology; not a separate pathogenicity database
computed_consequences.mechanism: LoF/GoF/NMD/PVS1 require gene-disease-transcript-specific manual evidence; plof_candidate is preliminary

vep_cache.note: Ensembl 115 GRCh38; archive and expanded files must validate

ensembl.note: Actual Ensembl/GENCODE versions from verified cache info.txt

gnomad_exomes.note: Versioned cached AF only; not full genomes, AN/coverage or a newer gnomAD release

gnomad_genomes.note: Versioned cached AF only; actual cache metadata authoritative

sift.note: Available only after verified cache metadata and control variants

polyphen2.note: Available only after verified cache metadata and control variants

dbsnp.note: rs identifiers/cache subset only; full dbSNP or build156 not assumed

hgmd_public_cache.note: Historical public cache component if actually present; not HGMD Professional

manual.clingen_vcep: Versioned gene-disease-specific CSpec/ACMG review; no automatic clinical classifier
manual.pubmed: PMID annotations are not downloaded full text or a systematic literature review
manual.genereviews: Permitted local documents/manual review; full bulk content not claimed
manual.orphanet: Manual context/permitted exports; full dump not installed by this command
manual.lovd: Database-specific permitted local export/manual review; no universal bulk mirror
manual.varsome: Secondary aggregator/manual review; no patient upload or assumed free full API

access_required.omim: No full licensed content provided; authorized local export/manual access required
access_required.dbnsfp: New authorized release/license/export required; Analysis1 dbNSFP4.9a not reused
access_required.hgmd_professional: Authorized local licensed export required; historical HGMD-PUBLIC cache is separate

optional.refseq_full: Full RefSeq/merged VEP cache not downloaded; MANE summary is only partial transcript metadata
optional.fathmm: Public legacy SQL/HMM backend not connected; no execution in an existing database
optional.cadd: Package/use terms and version must be reviewed before a separate large download; fourth video predictor uncertain
optional.revel: Official permitted release and normalized local adapter required; not downloaded
optional.spliceai: Permitted model/scores license and exact assembly/allele mapping required; not installed
optional.loftee: Implementation extra, not confirmed in lecture texts; dependencies and validation not prepared
optional.varity: Named in sources; versioned permitted local scores/adapter not installed
optional.metalr: Named in sources; versioned permitted local scores/adapter not installed
optional.maxentscan: Named in sources; local model/context validation not installed

missing_policy: Missing is not benign, reference, AF=0, or an ACMG criterion
